claims.value: Male figure (moai kavakava). The figure is missing one eye. There is no perforation at the back of the figure for suspension, a feature noted on some other moai kavakava. An ornate abstract figure is carved on the head of the object.
Höjd: 32 cm; Bredd: 8 cm; Djup: 6 cm
Namn - förvärvat från: Retzius, Gustaf (1842-10-17 - 1919-07-22), anatom, antropolog, tidningsman
